note: Probe of agent C (Qwen3-8B tokenizer): the prefix is encoded separately and appended after the generation prompt; each label probability is the sum over its token set, renormalised over A-H. Copied from e1_config.json.
score: FP32 logits; per label logsumexp over its token set; log_softmax over A-H; u = logsumexp of the seven non-top labels' log-probabilities (log non-top mass, PROTOCOL.md section 4); non-finite -> u = None, always waits for B; 1 - max p kept as u_1mp_diag (diagnostic only)
